articles.title: There's an election next month: State of Crypto

articles.title: Zcash Drops 21% From Recent High—Here’s Why the Rally May Not Be Over
articles.snippet: ZEC is 21% off its $1,698 peak after ETF outflows and a suspected North Korean heist routed money through its shielded pool. Is the run over, or will traders buy the dip?
